svg.text: Storage relationships — unified SQLite (schema v12 · PR #5901 snapshot-table foundation)
Per-table card: what it stores / written: when / read: by whom · red = write · blue = read · dashed = P2 (proposal end-state, not wired in this PR)
Archive layer · ingest bookkeeping (① writes · ②⑤ read)
written: once, first sight of session
read: L1 identity registry, legacy view
read: restart hydration, ckpt meta, status
read: plane derivation, legacy view, A/B check
written: on new bytes at ingest
folded blocks: summary + coverage range (start_seq, end_seq)
read: plane coverage mapping, legacy view
Plane · four new tables (#5901 · schema v12)
(sid,pos): core_ids + pre/post dual form + active + cover_ref
read: P2 egress, A/B check, GC
written: on fold (log depth ≥128 or compact)
read: rebuild anchor, seq lower bound, status
inc:* incremental lane / pf:state v5 watermark
read: lane features; plane skips inc: sessions
② read: messages / content / sessions.kstate / conversations + blocks
trigger: log depth ≥128 or a compact
S4 anchor moves into ckpt, log truncated
today kstate is authoritative; the plane ckpt is a mirror
cascades over ALL tables of A + B + C
when a B.blocks covering block vanishes
ivar release valve; rows never physically deleted in steady state (iv)
reads C four-table counts + dead-session list

This PR (P0+P1) = shadow flow: legacy tables as usual → the four new tables are write-only, never read for egress · proposal end-state (P2) = plane becomes the sole egress read source, absorbs kstate hydration, persists identity · rollback = DROP the four tables + unflag
